steps.name: Choose exhibit and species
steps.do: For **Exhibit**, choose **Africa Savanna**. In **Species**, type **African Lion** and select it from the suggestions.

steps.name: Date range + reason
steps.do: Leave **Start date** blank. Leave **Last day** blank. In **Reason**, enter a short note (e.g. **Manual test off display**).
steps.expect: Form is ready to save (blank **Start date** starts immediately; blank **Last day** stays off display until set on display).

steps.name: Submit off display
steps.expect: Success that **African Lion** in **Africa Savanna** was set as off display.

steps.name: Map without include
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to **today**. Leave **Include off display animals** unchecked.
steps.expect: **African Lion** is absent (or not shown as a normal on-display marker).

steps.name: Map with include
steps.expect: **African Lion** appears and/or an off-display banner/message is shown.

steps.name: Itinerary confirm
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Build for **today**, enable **Include off-display animals**, and try adding **African Lion**.
steps.expect: **Animal May Be Off Display** (or similar) appears.

steps.name: Set on display
steps.do: In Console, open **Set animal as on display**. Choose **Africa Savanna**, **African Lion**, and **Outdoor only**.

steps.name: Submit on display
steps.expect: Success that **African Lion** in **Africa Savanna** was set as on display.

steps.name: Map restored
steps.do: From the bottom nav, return to **Map** on **Specific Map** **today** with **Include off display animals** unchecked.
steps.expect: **African Lion** shows as a normal on-display marker again.

steps.name: Cleanup confirmed
steps.do: Confirm no leftover off-display state for **African Lion** today.
steps.expect: Guest map/itinerary treat **African Lion** as on display.
